capabilities.description: Ingests and versions the contract and BOQ as the source of record: parses document:harbourline_contract.pdf into clause terms (8.2 time for completion, 8.7 delay damages, 11.1 defects notification, 14.3 retention, 4.2 performance security) and document:harbourline_boq.xlsx into a priced item schedul

Prepares Interim Payment Certificates against BOQ items measured to date, applies Clause 14.3 retention of 5% per certificate with 50% release at Taking-Over and 50% at end of the Defects Notification Period, and runs an approval workflow over the certified valuation.

Tracks elapsed days against the Clause 8.2 time for completion of 730 days, records delay events, and computes delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10% per Clause 8.7 of document:harbourline_contract.pdf.

Registers inspection and test plans and QA records linked to BOQ work items and contract scope, capturing inspection outcomes, sign-offs and hold points with an auditable evidence trail for handover and the Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period.

Maintains a controlled document register for contract, BOQ, drawings, ITPs and correspondence: assigns revisions, tracks transmittals and status, and links each register entry to its source document (document:harbourline_contract.pdf, document:harbourline_boq.xlsx) with version history.

Consolidates claim status, certified value, retention held, delay-days accrued and delay-damages exposure against the Clause 8.7 cap, plus QA/ITP and document-register status, into role-based views for the contracts administrator and project management.

product_name: Harbourline Civil Works Contracts Administration Platform
summary: A contract-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that treats the uploaded contract (harbourline_contract.pdf) and BOQ (harbourline_boq.xlsx) as the single source of record. It serves the project's contracts administrator and commercial team, governing progress claims (IPC preparation with Clause 14.3 retention), delay-damages tracking against Clause 8.7 and the Clause 8.2 time for completion, QA/ITP records, and a controlled document register. Uploaded contract and BOQ
